prompt.project_info: Create a high-end editorial portrait of an approved adult woman seated on modern stairs under purple and pink neon light.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with dark brown hair in a chic messy high bun, soft strands framing her face, light eye makeup, pink/nude lips, and a subtle engaging smile. She wears a black floor-length backless evening gown with thin straps and high slit, plus gold leopard-print ankle-wrap sandals. She sits turned partly away and looks back toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait on wide concrete or stone stairs, one leg extended down the steps and the other bent in a natural editorial pose, dark purple/pink neon gradient background, sharp face and shoes with shallow neon bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic high-contrast cinematic lighting, purple and pink/red neon glow, controlled key light on skin and dress texture, glamorous fashion-editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R IV-style 85mm f/1.4 portrait, photorealistic high detail, shallow depth of field, realistic satin/fabric and shoe texture, natural skin, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end photorealistic editorial portrait of an approved adult woman with dark brown hair in a chic messy high bun and soft face-framing strands, light eye makeup, pink-nude lips, and a subtle engaging smile. She sits on wide modern concrete stairs in a black floor-length backless evening gown with thin straps and a high slit, wearing gold leopard-print ankle-wrap sandals. One leg extends naturally down the stairs and the other bends, while she turns partly away and looks back toward the camera. Use a dramatic purple and pink/red neon gradient background, high-contrast cinematic lighting, controlled highlights on skin and dress, Sony-style 85mm f/1.4 perspective, sharp face and shoes, shallow neon bokeh, realistic texture, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
